check:
printf 'example.com. 3600 IN SOA ns.example.com. admin.example.com. 1 7200 3600 1209600 3600
example.com. 3600 IN NS ns.example.com.
ns.example.com. 3600 IN A 192.0.2.1
' > check.zone; key=$(examples/ldns-keygen -a ED25519 example.com); examples/ldns-signzone check.zone "$key"; examples/ldns-verify-zone -k "$key.ds" check.zone.signed 2>/dev/null || examples/ldns-verify-zone check.zone.signed; examples/ldns-read-zone check.zone.signed | grep -q RRSIG; drill/drill -v
